messages:
alex: Quick Q on per-route rate limiting contract — how should runtime signal when a short burst drains the route bucket but shared/buffer tokens remain? Current header plan: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-RateLimit-Bucket. Also proposing 429 response body with structured fields. Any objections to including bucket id both as a header and inside the 429 JSON for easier debugging?

maria: I think header + body is fine. Proxies/readers usually look at headers first though. Maybe keep header minimal and put details in body. :thinking_face:

priya: We landed on a header called `X-RateLimit-Bucket` in the design review, and agreed the 429 body should include `bucket` so SDKs can surface it. For backcompat: clients should tolerate missing bucket (treat as unknown). Suggest a stable prefix for bucket ids, e.g. `ri:`.

alex: OK plan: header `X-RateLimit-Bucket: ri:acct:route:v1`. Example 429 (for docs):

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1853001141
X-RateLimit-Bucket: ri:acct123:embed-route:v1
Retry-After: 30

{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "message": "rate limit exceeded",
    "reason": "quota-exceeded",
    "retry_after": 30,
    "bucket": "ri:acct123:embed-route:v1"
  }
}
```

sam: We should also specify what happens when the request is throttled by a shared fallback pool (burst smoothing). Do we surface `bucket: "ri:shared:burst"` or a different key?

priya: Yes, include `bucket` and add `bucket_type` = `route` | `shared` in the body if we need to differentiate. That keeps parsers forward-compatible.

maria: Important for backcompat: some clients only check `error.message` text. Keep that stable (`"rate limit exceeded"`) and add the machine `reason` field (`quota-exceeded`) for programmatic handling.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RFC PR opened for header+body contract: https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/482 (includes examples and bucket id format)

alex: Can @sam @priya do a quick CR on the RFC and add a JSON schema for the 429 body? If no objections by EOD I'll merge the API change and file SDK follow-ups. :thumbsup:

sam: +1 — I'll review by noon and add a testcase for shared-burst bucket naming.

priya: I'll add parser tests in runtime and a note in the batching docs about when shared pool gets used.

alex: Great. Follow-ups I'm tracking: [1] spec merge, [2] SDK error class update, [3] docs samples expanded. Ping me on the PR for any last-minute tweaks.
